detail: Registration, four onboarding pages, Home, wellness and Profile passed. Other features are not covered by this suite.

checkpoints.name: 01-login
checkpoints.description: Login opens without a saved session

checkpoints.name: 02-register
checkpoints.description: Register accepts test account name and email

checkpoints.name: 05-otp-requested
checkpoints.description: Register OTP requested for the specified email

checkpoints.name: 06-otp-verified
checkpoints.description: OTP authenticates test account and opens onboarding

checkpoints.name: 07-basic-valid
checkpoints.description: Synthetic birth date, gender, weight, height and training days validate

checkpoints.name: 08-health
checkpoints.description: Synthetic no-condition and no-injury answers selected

checkpoints.name: 09-goal
checkpoints.description: Only increased-endurance health goal selected; no distance goal

checkpoints.name: 11-home
checkpoints.description: Onboarding completes and Home shows test account

checkpoints.name: 12-wellness-valid
checkpoints.description: Five required wellness scores enable Save

checkpoints.name: 13-wellness-saved
checkpoints.description: Real API accepts wellness and Home updates

checkpoints.name: 14-profile
checkpoints.description: Profile loads test account and public UID without a retry error

scope: Selected assertions only. Other UAT cases remain Not Run. No account deletion.
